fields.label: Enable Neotec AI
fields.description: When on, the Ask Neotec AI panel on the Reports screen sends live report figures to the endpoint below.

fields.label: AI Provider
fields.description: OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, vLLM and LM Studio. Use Anthropic (Claude) for Claude, and Azure OpenAI for OpenAI models hosted on Azure.

fields.label: AI Endpoint (OpenAI-compatible base URL)
fields.description: OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1 · Gemini: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ · Ollama: http://<host>:11434/v1 · Claude: leave blank (https://api.anthropic.com) · Azure: https://<resource>.openai.azure.com

fields.label: Model
fields.description: The provider's model name, e.g. gpt-4.1-mini, gemini-3.8-flash, llama3.3, claude-sonnet-5-5. For Azure, the deployment name.

fields.label: API Key (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank for local engines (Ollama/LM Studio).

fields.label: Max Answer Tokens
fields.description: Upper limit for one answer. Claude requires a limit; others use it if given.

fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: How long one call may take. Calls run in the background, so this is not limited by the web gateway.

fields.label: System Prompt (optional)
fields.description: Override the default analyst persona. Leave blank to use the built-in prompt.

fields.label: Arabic Label Sources
fields.description: Map each master to the field that holds its Arabic name. When the UI language is Arabic, accounts / dimensions / company show that field's value. The selectable value (used for filtering) never changes — only the displayed label.

fields.label: Ollama URL
fields.description: Local Ollama endpoint. Keeps slip data on-prem (PDPL).

fields.label: Ollama Text Model
fields.description: Structures digital-PDF text into the slip schema.

fields.label: Company Name Tokens (direction classifier)
fields.description: Distinctive tokens that identify your company on bank slips. Accounts are read from company Bank Accounts; these cover name-only slips.
